sources: ToS;DR & Terms of Service Corpus (tosdr/browser-extensions & sonu-gupta/tosdr-terms-of-service-corpus)

taxonomies.name: Fake Urgency & Countdown Pressure
taxonomies.description: Imposes an artificial or resetting deadline on a sale or reservation to accelerate user decision-making.

signatures.name: Expiring Deal Phrase
signatures.regex: offer expires in|deal ends in|flash sale ends|price expires in|limited[- ]time offer

signatures.name: High-Pressure Action Prompt
signatures.regex: hurry!|act fast|last chance to book|book now before prices rise|don't miss out
signatures.example: Last chance to book at this fare!

taxonomies.name: Artificial Scarcity
taxonomies.description: Signals limited availability of a digital or abundant item to inflate perceived value.

signatures.name: Low Stock Claim
signatures.regex: only \d+ left( in stock| at this price| on our site)?|almost gone|selling fast
signatures.example: Only 1 left in stock at this price (₹42,999)!

signatures.name: High Demand Depletion Claim
signatures.regex: in high demand|9[0-9]% of rooms booked|sold out soon|limited seats remaining
signatures.example: In high demand — 98% of seats booked on this route

taxonomies.name: Manipulative Social Proof & Activity Messages
taxonomies.academic_source: Mathur et al. (Princeton CHI 2019) / DPBH EthiGuard
taxonomies.description: Displays unverified or fabricated real-time viewer counts and recent purchases to trigger herd behavior.

signatures.name: Concurrent Viewer Pressure
signatures.example: 38 people are viewing this flight right now!

signatures.name: Recent Purchase Ticker
signatures.example: 42 people bought this in the last hour

taxonomies.name: Sneaking & Pre-Selected Add-Ons
taxonomies.academic_source: Brignull / DPBH EthiGuard / EU Digital Services Act Art. 25
taxonomies.description: Sneaks extra paid items, recurring subscriptions, or data sharing into the basket via pre-checked boxes or hidden drip fees.

signatures.name: Pre-Checked Opt-In Checkbox
signatures.example: <input type='checkbox' checked /> Add ₹2,499 VIP Baggage Protection

signatures.name: Hidden Trial-to-Paid Conversion
signatures.regex: auto[- ]?enroll.*for [₹$€£]\d+|after \d+ days you will be charged|automatically billed
signatures.example: Auto-enroll me in ShadyClub Gold for ₹999/month after 7 days

taxonomies.name: Confirm-Shaming & Visual Interference
taxonomies.description: Manipulates users into opting in by wording the decline option to induce guilt and styling it with low contrast or tiny typography.

signatures.name: Guilt-Inducing Opt-Out Copy
signatures.regex: no thanks,?\s*i (don't|do not) (want|like)|no,?\s*i prefer to pay full price|i hate saving money|continue without protection|no thanks,?\s*i'll risk it|risk losing my luggage
signatures.example: No thanks, I prefer to pay full price and risk losing my luggage

signatures.name: Asymmetric Button Visual Interference (Consent-O-Matic Rule)
signatures.example: 18px bold green primary CTA vs. 10px #cbd5e1 muted grey opt-out link
